name: Șablon de proiect România
summary: A project template set up the Romanian way: storeys named Fundații, Parter, Etaj 1 and Mansardă, and the parameters a building permit's documents ask for.
description: An example project template made by Ciuntuc BIM Studio. Installed, it is in File → New from template…; a new project from it has the storeys and empty project parameters for the height regime, the plot's area, POT, CUT and the importance category and class. Check its settings against your own office standards.

items: Parametri: regim de înălțime, suprafață teren, POT, CUT, categoria și clasa de importanță
